_note: Numbers invented for damage, time, crit, streak, enemy-skip and utility rules. min_enemy_damage: an enemy hit never does less than this. rounding: round = half goes up, floor = always down, ceil = always up. time_limit_seconds: seconds per question by difficulty. typed_extra_seconds: extra seconds for a typed answer. min_time_limit_seconds: a question never gets less time than this after equipment adjustments. crit_difficulties: only these difficulties can critically hit. crit_tiers: a fast answer can deal more damage; the share is measured against the normal time limit, before item bonuses. streak: bonus_per_right for each right answer in a row, up to max_multiplier. enemy_skip_chance: chance the enemy skips its turn after a miss. utility: war_cry_bonus boosts the next attack; reveal_wrong_choices_removed removes wrong choices from the next multiple-choice question; evasion_attacks sets how many enemy attacks are covered; evasion_miss_chance is the chance a covered attack misses. Tier damage and bonus_damage are in moves.json; enemy damage is in enemies.json.
